A '''battle''' occurred at [[Immalia]] during the [[Waymancy Storm]]. It was during this battle that an experimental energy skin was first deployed, via the [[cannonship]] ''[[Squintpipe]]'', and which successfully threaded the enemy formation at Immalia.
